delta_cv_increment: held-out identity score(T_shared+Delta) - score(T_shared), replaying committed lambda_delta only

confidence.DECOMPOSITION_CONFIDENCE_HIGH: no boundary concern AND median DELTA_CV_INCREMENT > 0.005
confidence.DECOMPOSITION_CONFIDENCE_MODERATE: boundary concern but median DELTA_CV_INCREMENT > 0 OR no concern but increment ~0
confidence.DECOMPOSITION_CONFIDENCE_LOW: boundary concern AND median DELTA_CV_INCREMENT <= 0 (Delta shrunk to ~0; shared fraction mechanically inflated)

preserve: SHARED_COMPONENT_DOMINANT label unchanged; only confidence is reported
